name: 20/20 Connector Catalog
securityRule: API keys are credentials, not skills. This archive stores credential names and connector requirements only; it never stores secret key values.

connectors.name: Web search
connectors.notes: Optional. Use a provider-specific server-side secret if a paid or authenticated search endpoint is selected.

connectors.name: Document store
connectors.notes: Use scoped access to the selected archive; do not expose the token to client-side JavaScript.

connectors.name: MCP server
connectors.access: Defined per MCP server and tool
connectors.notes: Prefer separate credentials for read-only resources and mutating tools.

connectors.name: Secrets vault
connectors.notes: The archive should store only a vault reference and scope, never the secret value.

connectors.name: Audit log
connectors.notes: Mask credentials and personal data in logs.

connectors.name: Provider API
connectors.notes: Use a restricted key, server-side storage, rotation, revocation, and request monitoring.
